payload.reason: The evidence provides specific existing techniques that the authors compare against, including references to specific case studies and techniques used in those studies.

claims.text: The authors compare MERF against existing application-specific techniques, including ANGE, ATEEMA, and GENTREE.
The comparison includes case studies on narrator chain, temporal entity, and genealogy entity extraction tasks.
The authors also compare a MERF number normalization task to a task-specific implementation.
